name: com.nexus.ads
description: Engine-independent ad core (placements, PolicyGuard, state machine, retry) with a Unity layer, an editor setup wizard and validator, and a simulator provider. Mediation SDKs are separate provider packages; Nexus games connect through com.nexus.ads.bridge.nexus.

samples.description: Ads without Nexus: one component over the static Ads facade, in-memory settings when the project has none, the simulator in the editor.
A Nexus game's wiring: AdService and the factory bound in a lifecycle, NexusAdsBridge.Connect, game code against IAdService only.
